== Original printed-face source; card data unchanged ==
Added the [https://web.archive.org/web/20080512202708/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/r3t6.html archived original Decipher card page] as an explicitly labeled original printed-face source. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20030622013906im_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/r3t6.gif original black-border scan] and current wiki image were visually checked. The original face has no printed Nav Computer icon. The existing navigation capability is retained: the Decipher Glossary, pp. 15 and 94, explains that astromech droids provide nav computers. The rules source is distinct from the printed-face citation; no icon field was changed. Existing secondary sources are retained. No game text, lore, stats, icons, UID, version label, image, printings or sibling page was changed; the citation does not certify the current data as identical to the original face. == Correct combo location to the original printed Central Core ==
Corrected the wiki combo list from "Death Star: Central Corridor" to "Death Star: Central Core," as shown on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030622013906im_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/r3t6.gif original printed R3-T6 face]. The similarly worded attributed strategy passage is preserved with an editorial source note; this does not claim that its specific archived strategy capture has been revalidated or establish whether that location name originated in the source or its transcription. The supporting reference now identifies the exact PC Dark.json record and its conflicting combo name. The original card's "adds 1" hyperspeed text, all card fields, original Sources, image, identity, version links, and the separate PC Errata sibling are unchanged.
